description: Add custom robots.txt route in edge worker that allows AI crawlers, and create sitemap generation endpoints in the backend (sitemap index, sitemap-chapters.xml with deduplication, sitemap-subjects.xml, sitemap-static.xml)
steps: Create apps/edge/src/routes/robots.ts that exports a handler returning a custom robots.txt response. Content: User-agent: * Allow: / Disallow: /api/ Disallow: /admin/ Disallow: /profile. Then specifically Allow GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended (no disallow). Block CCBot and Bytespider with Disallow: /. Include Sitemap: https://syrabit.ai/sitemap.xml directive.

In apps/edge/src/index.ts, add a route check BEFORE the /api/ block: if url.pathname === '/robots.txt', call the robots handler and return its response. This overrides Cloudflare's managed robots.txt.

Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/seo.py as a new FastAPI router with these endpoints: (a) GET /api/seo/sitemap.xml - sitemap index pointing to sub-sitemaps, (b) GET /api/seo/sitemap-subjects.xml - all subject landing pages, (c) GET /api/seo/sitemap-chapters.xml - all chapter pages with URL deduplication (use a set to track seen URLs), (d) GET /api/seo/sitemap-static.xml - static pages like /home, /pricing, /about, /library, /login, /signup.

The sitemap endpoints should query the same library-bundle endpoint the prerender uses (or directly query MongoDB collections if available) to enumerate all boards/classes/subjects/chapters. Use XML response with proper Content-Type: application/xml header.
The sitemap-chapters endpoint MUST deduplicate URLs - use a Python set() to track emitted loc values and skip duplicates.
Register the SEO router in apps/backend/app/main.py: app.include_router(seo.router, prefix='/api/seo', tags=['SEO']). Import it alongside the other v1 routers.
In apps/edge/src/index.ts, add a route for /sitemap.xml (and /sitemap-*.xml) that proxies to the backend /api/seo/ endpoints. This ensures sitemap.xml is served at the root domain.

Add a test file apps/backend/tests/test_seo.py with basic tests: (a) test sitemap index returns valid XML with sub-sitemap references, (b) test sitemap-static returns expected static routes, (c) test sitemap-chapters deduplicates URLs.
acceptance_criteria: GET /robots.txt returns custom robots.txt with AI crawler allowances
CCBot and Bytespider are blocked in robots.txt
Sitemap: https://syrabit.ai/sitemap.xml directive is present in robots.txt
GET /api/seo/sitemap.xml returns valid XML sitemap index
Edge worker TypeScript compiles with the new routes
Backend seo.py router is registered in main.py
Backend tests for SEO endpoints pass
